note: Evidence could not be gathered — this is a tooling failure, NOT a finding of absence. Per Rule 5 I am not converting 'could not check' into 'no shipments found', so both statuses are 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'. Nothing here supports or refutes the claimed HS codes 200819/200989/210690 (fruit/nut and juice preparations, food preparations) or the claimed proprietor 'DEEPANSHU AGARWAL'; no CIN, PAN, GSTIN or revenue figure was obtained and none is invented. Note the name ambiguity: 'Anagh Foods' vs 'Anaghaya' may be two different entities, and the importkey template renders for any slug, so its page existence proves nothing about the company. Recommended re-run with working search access, and a check of the MCA/zaubacorp record to confirm the legal entity exists before any verdict; no rejection is proposed on this evidence.
